title: Chain-of-Agents: Native End-to-End Complex Problem Solving with One Model

defines.name: Chain-of-Agents (CoA)
defines.definition: A reasoning paradigm that enables one LLM to dynamically activate multiple tool agents and role-playing agents to simulate multi-agent collaboration end-to-end within a single model.

defines.name: Agent Foundation Models (AFMs)
defines.definition: Models trained to natively perform Chain-of-Agents problem solving in the same way as a multi-agent system.

problem: Existing multi-agent systems are computationally inefficient, depend on manual prompt and workflow engineering, and cannot be improved well through data-centric end-to-end training.
